window: prior: first public before 2023-03; [concurrent]: 2023-03 to 2024-03; [later]: after 2024-03. Ledger index gives years only: prior period counted as index year <= 2022, 2023 items listed separately, undated reported as date unresolved.
setting: Human studies that reconstruct speech acoustics from intracranial recordings during produced speech (the published intracranial-synthesis population for M06 and M08; the published intracranial speech population for M12; all non-acoustic-to-speech synthesis for M02, as in the published M02 table). Same setting definition across slots; novelty precedents from any signal.
prep: no prep/ directory; plan and audits built by the writer

inherited.M01: Overt production of 50 words in five elicitation tasks (same-group paradigm, Wang 2021 preprint / PNAS 2023)
inherited.M03: Per-participant models; speech autoencoder pretrained per participant; loss weights tuned on three hybrid-density participants
inherited.M05: Clinical subdural ECoG, 43 low-density and 5 hybrid-density grids, high-gamma 70-150 Hz envelope
inherited.M11: Participant's own recorded audio as reference

topics.inclusion_rule: The published intracranial-synthesis population (studies whose ledger text names an intracranial signal and speech synthesis or spectrogram reconstruction; 180 unique studies), classified by the intermediate representation between neural features and sound that its full text names: direct (mel/log/linear) spectrogram regression, articulatory kinematic intermediate, vocoder-parameter target (LPC, WORLD, LPCNet, cepstra), GAN latent, self-supervised or codec units, differentiable parametric synthesizer (DDSP-style). Boundary: mention counts (upper bounds); the pattern also admits reviews, perception and lip or EMG studies that cite intracranial work; versions once; formant-parameter decoders driving a rule-based synthesizer (Guenther 2009) count as interpretable acoustic parameters but not as differentiable synthesis.
topics.metric: spectrogram PCC (higher), same-cohort and same-task where available

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that synthesize speech from a non-acoustic signal and supervise the signal encoder with paired speech, either by direct spectral regression or by matching the latent of a speech encoder or autoencoder that is not used at test time; design of interest here: training-only reference parameters from a speech autoencoder.
topics.metric: presence of the design; spectrogram PCC

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: intracranial production-speech reconstruction, classified by how predicted acoustic features become a waveform (neural vocoder, Griffin-Lim, parametric vocoder, unit selection).
topics.metric: presence of the design; listener tests

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: intracranial speech decoding studies classified by how test data are separated from training data (random trial split, k-fold, held-out session or day, held-out subject); added here: held-out words.
topics.metric: spectrogram PCC on unseen participants or words
